pr_title: cli/quit: clean up some now-unneeded code
pr_body:
Fixes #49359

Since gRPC has been updated, some error handling code was not any more
needed.

Release note: None
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/49366)

issue_context.title: cli: simplify grpcConfusedErrConnClosedByPeer
issue_context.body:
According to https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/pull/49114#issuecomment-629271590, we should be able to remove

https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/blob/a8ae1bf96c5900aecee4471ae89f35b8bbc6b6af/pkg/cli/quit.go#L288

because we have since picked up https://github.com/grpc/grpc-go/pull/3054.

review_comments: If this were still needed, how would we find out?
